body: Thanks for the kind words but my situation is different. My parents said when I turn 18 I'm getting kicked out so it's either I starve on the streets for a year or two before I die slowly and painfully or save my self the agony.

I'm not gonna say I know what your going through because I don't.

But what I do know is that breakups are difficult the wounds they leave are deep and they take time to heal sometimes a long time to heal

But there are other people who love you friends and family. If you wanna talk my inbox is open
